items.headline: AI Filmmaking Debated by Alibaba, Sonilo, PROMPTR at Venice Panel
items.excerpt: At Venice Production Bridge, executives from Alibaba Token Hub, Sonilo and PROMPTR argued generative video is landing first in pre-production. Alibaba said HappyHorse 2.0 and a real-time 'world model' companion, HappyHorse Control, ship by end of September.

items.headline: Tamar AI's TapNow Brings AI-Native Filmmaking to Venice Production Bridge
items.excerpt: Tamar AI pitched TapNow as an AI-native creative operating system bundling multimodal models, agents and production workflow in one environment. Three films made under its 10,000 Parallel Universes program screened at Venice.

items.headline: Adobe Unveils New Generative Media Tool in Premiere, Plus More AI-Powered Updates
items.excerpt: Adobe's IBC 2026 release puts a Generative Media Tool directly on the Premiere timeline, letting editors generate video and sound effects in place. It routes to Firefly plus partner models including Google Veo, Kling, Runway and Luma.

items.headline: Eddie AI v4 adds Avid support, C2PA signing, and generative b-roll
items.excerpt: Eddie AI v4 adds native Avid Media Composer handoff, automatic camera sync, and generative music, voiceover and b-roll. It also signs output with C2PA content credentials and offers a smaller on-premises model for facilities.

items.headline: SNS Adds AI Suite Advanced, Avid Media Composer Support to EVO
items.excerpt: Studio Network Solutions expanded the AI layer inside its EVO shared storage, pushing transcription, tagging and search onto the facility's own hardware. The IBC update also widens Avid Media Composer compatibility.

items.headline: The director of 'HOPE' breaks down those chase scenes, and mocap with Vikander and Fassbender
items.excerpt: A breakdown of how 'HOPE' staged its chase sequences and captured performances from Alicia Vikander and Michael Fassbender on a motion-capture stage. The piece also covers how the film's creatures were designed.

items.headline: AI-Generated Verticals Are Flooding the Microdrama Apps That Kept Crews Working
items.excerpt: Phone-first microdramas became a post-strike lifeline for underemployed LA cast and crew. Now AI-generated verticals are saturating the same apps, and auditions are drying up.

items.headline: Daniel Kwan and Joseph Gordon-Levitt's CCAI Launches a Site to Define AI's Impact
items.excerpt: The Concerned Creatives coalition led by Daniel Kwan and Joseph Gordon-Levitt is publishing a living web resource mapping how AI is actually hitting creative work. It aims to give filmmakers shared evidence rather than vibes.

items.headline: Guillermo Del Toro On What Artists Lose To AI: 'You're Never A Master; You're Always An Apprentice'
items.excerpt: Del Toro uses the Pale Man, practical effects and creative accidents to argue what disappears when process is replaced by prompting. His framing is about craft apprenticeship, not copyright.
